thread:
ravi (VP Eng): quick live-thread from today's runtime Q&A — thanks for all the questions. two clarifications requested: 1) exact per-route batching/caching guardrails and 2) who owns kernel-v4 day-to-day perf triage.

sam (Runtime): short version: low-latency routes: max batch delay 5ms, max batch size 8. balanced routes: 12ms / size 32. background routes: 25ms / size 128. KV-cache defaults unchanged but pin-hints available under a canary flag. all knobs are route-configurable.

noor (Kernel): i'll take day-to-day owning for kernel-v4 perf triage (hotspots, microkernel PRs). sam will own deployment/rollout infra and canary logic. i'll keep an open kanban and tag owners.

lena (Product): customers asked about SLO tradeoffs — can we publish acceptable p95 delta windows per route class?

em (SRE): SRE needs explicit thresholds: for low-latency routes p95 must not exceed baseline + 2ms sustained >5min. for balanced p95 +5ms allowed; background routes unlimited but monitor for regressions. we'll formalize in SLO doc.

sam (Runtime): adding: automatic fallback policy if p95 breach: degrade batching aggressiveness one step; if still > threshold, switch to v3-compatible variant. we'll surface these events in the console.

ci-bot: [canary-schedule] kernel-v4-internal-canary -> dedicated-eu1 @ 2025-06-10T08:30Z.

mira (Docs): action: i'll publish a one-pager "What to expect during kernel-v4 canary" with SDK migration notes and route config examples. draft ETA Wed EOD.

noor (Kernel): testing matrix: microbench (latency at short seq), kv-cache interaction tests, and quantized variant P50/P95 across prompt buckets. i'll post the matrix later today.

lena (Product): opt-out UX for enterprise: we need a per-tenant toggle + audit log entry. sam, can you scope how quick that is?

sam (Runtime): per-tenant toggle is doable via policy flags; dev work estimate 3 days to expose UI + API. audit log we can add as event on toggle change.

em (SRE): preflight checklist: 1) dashboard heatmap for p50/p95 delta (per-model), 2) alert thresholds for rollback, 3) runbook dry-run. i'll post checklist by tomorrow.

ravi (VP Eng): excellent. quick config example we'll include in docs:

```
# route policy example
route: low-latency
batch:
  max_delay_ms: 5
  max_size: 8
cache:
  enabled: true
  ttl_minutes: 30
  pin_hints: false  # canary: true to opt-in
```

noor (Kernel): owners recap: noor = kernel perf owner (PR triage), sam = infra/canary owner, em = SRE readiness, mira = docs, lena = product liaison.

ci-bot: [note] canary gate: must pass perf-smoke and eval-parity before canary opens to external customers.

mira (Docs): docs action list: one-pager, SDK streaming note, opt-out UX copy.

sam (Runtime): i'll add the automatic-bailout logic to the runbook and post the runbook link here when ready.

em (SRE): i'll schedule chaos-check and the dry-run 48h pre-deploy.

ravi (VP Eng): thanks all. action items recap in one line: sam -> runbook + policy knobs; noor -> perf kanban + test matrix; em -> preflight checklist + chaos; mira -> docs one-pager; lena -> enterprise opt-out UX. i'll follow up in leadership sync Friday. ping me if you want to join the canary readiness call tomorrow 9am PT. :rocket:
